title: Settings › Help & about has a Getting started row that always reopens the screen: ring + progress line, All set when done, a note when hidden from the account menu, Open
steps: S1: run the tracy-onboard help-row tests (node:test, jsdom page, fake account flags and status copy) and the tracy-settings Help & about tests (server render of the section with a recording renderSlot).

S2: the end-to-end form: open Settings › Help & about on the web or in the desktop app; the Getting started row sits after the update rows and before What's new; press Open; the Getting started screen opens with the eyebrow 'Getting started with Tracy Cowork'.
expect: In progress (web, no AI account): .ts-help-row[data-help-item='getting-started'] with title 'Getting started', a decorative (aria-hidden) ring whose arc offset is C·(1−2/3), the line '2 of 3 setup steps complete.' and a button 'Open' wearing the class the section hands over.
Every step done: the ring shows a tick instead of the arc and the line reads 'All set. Open it again any time.'; the row stays.
Hidden from the account menu: the line ends with '· Hidden from the account menu' (the dot aria-hidden); the row stays.
Open opens the screen in reopened mode; Show in account menu there clears the note underneath without a reload.
Operator switch 'onboarding' off: no row. Through apply(): registered into settings.help.item with id tracy-onboard.getting-started, order 10, locale tracy-onboard.

Help & about renders settings.help.item once, after the update row and its switches and before the release notes (web: after the web line, before the links), handing over buttonClassName equal to the class of its own 'Check for updates' button.

tests: in progress: the section's row, the ring at 2 of 3, the line and an Open button with the section's class
every step done: a tick in the ring and "All set. Open it again any time." — the row stays
hidden from the account menu: the line says so after a separator — the row stays
Open opens the screen in reopened mode; Show in account menu there clears the note underneath
the operator switched Getting started off: no row
through apply(): the row registers into settings.help.item after the updates
the help items sit after the update row and its switches, before the release notes
on the web the help items follow the web line, inside the first box, before the links
the section as registered renders the settings.help.item slot, handing over the button class

fence: tracy-settings never imports onboard: the row arrives through the settings.help.item slot it declares, and the operator's onboarding switch is the only thing that removes it
